_source: Transcribed from the school's own Class Routine, Weekly Program and Menu posters, supplied by admin@littlecaterpillars.co.za in September 2026. These are NOT from the Wayback captures — they are current documents and they resolve part of the brief's "DOWNLOADS ... none are recoverable" gap. Obvious spelling slips in the posters are corrected here and listed in TODO_CONFIRM.md.
